stories.headline: Trump Sends Witkoff and Kushner to Pakistan for New Iran Talks as Araghchi Arrives in Islamabad

key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump to send envoys to Pakistan, with JD Vance, who led talks with Iran in Islamabad nearly two weeks ago, on 'standby'

key_facts.fact: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi landed in Islamabad on Friday but did not confirm direct talks with the US
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has landed in Pakistan, but Iranian media did not confirm talks with the US

key_facts.fact: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said the US blockade on Iranian ports will remain in place 'until necessary'
key_facts.excerpt: Iran and the US remain locked in a standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, with Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth saying blockade on Iranian ports will remain in place 'until necessary'

key_facts.fact: Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the ceasefire by three weeks, Trump announced on Thursday
key_facts.excerpt: Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the ceasefire by three weeks, US President Donald Trump said

key_facts.fact: The US froze $344 million in cryptocurrency assets linked to Iran as part of its pressure campaign on Tehran
key_facts.excerpt: The US has frozen $344 million (€239.5 million) in cryptocurrency assets over ties to Iran, the US Treasury Secretary said

key_facts.fact: This is the second attempt at peace talks; the first round in Islamabad was led by VP Vance nearly two weeks ago

stories.headline: Taiwan's Stock Market Surpasses UK at $4.3T as AI Chip Boom Reshuffles Global Equity Rankings

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's stock market, valued at nearly $4.3 trillion, surpassed the United Kingdom — Europe's biggest market — earlier this month
key_facts.excerpt: With its stock market now valued at nearly $4.3 trillion, Taiwan surpassed the United Kingdom, Europe's biggest market, earlier this month

key_facts.fact: South Korea is about $140 billion away from also surpassing the UK; both Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months
key_facts.excerpt: South Korea is about $140 billion away from doing the same. The tech-heavy Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months.

key_facts.fact: TSMC shares have climbed more than 40% this year, while Samsung and SK Hynix have surged more than 80% each
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC shares have climbed more than 40% this year, while the Korean duo have surged more than 80% each.

key_facts.fact: TSMC's market cap stands at $1.8 trillion, while Samsung and SK Hynix combined at $1.5 trillion — all individually larger than Europe's biggest tech company, ASML
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC now ranks among the largest companies in the world, with its market capitalisation of $1.8 trillion, and the Korean pair combined at $1.5 trillion. Europe's largest company, chip-equipment maker ASML Holding NV, is smaller than all of them.

key_facts.fact: The combined market cap of all technology stocks in the Stoxx Europe 600 Index stands at about $1.4 trillion, less than TSMC alone
key_facts.excerpt: the combined market cap of all technology stocks in the Stoxx Europe 600 Index stands at about $1.4 trillion

stories.headline: FDA Grants Priority Review Vouchers to Three Psychedelic Drug Programs, First Approval Possible by Summer

key_facts.fact: The FDA awarded national priority vouchers to Compass Pathways (psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression), Usona Institute (psilocybin for major depressive disorder), and Transcend Therapeutics (methylone for PTSD)
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA is awarding national priority vouchers to Compass Pathways, Transcend Therapeutics and the Usona Institute as the Trump administration looks for ways to support advances in psychedelic medicine.

key_facts.fact: FDA Commissioner Marty Makary said the first psychedelic drug could be approved in the US as soon as this summer
key_facts.excerpt: FDA Commissioner Marty Makary told NBC News that the first psychedelic drug could be approved in the U.S. as soon as this summer.

key_facts.fact: The vouchers cut FDA review time from a year to just 1-2 months after an application is filed
key_facts.excerpt: can cut the time it takes for FDA approval from a year to just a few months

key_facts.fact: Compass Pathways' COMP360 phase 3 trial with over 1,000 participants showed effects within a day that lasted at least six months for clinically meaningful responders
key_facts.excerpt: In a phase 3 trial that included more than 1,000 participants, Compass says that patients with TRD experienced effects within a day of treatment that lasted at least six months

key_facts.fact: The action came days after Trump signed an executive order to accelerate access to psychedelic mental health treatments
key_facts.excerpt: Just days after President Donald Trump's executive order focused on accelerating access to mental health treatments, the FDA has announced a series of regulatory actions

key_facts.fact: Critics say the program was put in place without congressional input and could undermine trust in FDA's regulatory process
key_facts.excerpt: Critics of the program say it was put in place without seeking input from Congress, and could ultimately undermine trust in the FDA's regulatory process

stories.headline: ESA Demolishes Russian Soyuz Rocket Launch Complex in French Guiana, MaiaSpace to Reuse 80% of Site

key_facts.fact: The European Space Agency carried out a controlled explosion of the 52-meter mobile service tower at the Soyuz-ST launch complex at the Kourou spaceport in French Guiana on April 24
key_facts.excerpt: the demolition included a controlled explosion of a 52-meter mobile service tower that had been part of the Soyuz launch infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Prior to the demolition, the 'tulip' — four truss supports that held the rocket before launch — and cable masts had already been cut
key_facts.excerpt: Before that, the so-called 'tulip'—four truss supports that held the rocket before launch—and the cable masts were cut

key_facts.fact: MaiaSpace, a French startup affiliated with Arianespace, plans to reuse up to 80% of the existing infrastructure for its own launch vehicle program
key_facts.excerpt: The company plans to reuse up to 80% of the existing infrastructure for its own launch vehicle program.

key_facts.fact: MaiaSpace is developing a two-stage rocket powered by Prometheus methane-fueled engines, with the first launch scheduled for 2027
key_facts.excerpt: MaiaSpace is developing a two-stage rocket, Maia, with both expendable and partially reusable configurations... The first launch of the Maia rocket is currently scheduled for 2027.

key_facts.fact: The demolition ends a 15-year cooperation program between ESA and Roscosmos known as 'Soyuz at Kourou'
key_facts.excerpt: The dismantling of the Soyuz launch site follows the collapse of a 15-year cooperation program between ESA and Roscosmos known as 'Soyuz at Kourou.'

key_facts.excerpt: DOJ attorneys wrote in the 19-page complaint, which was filed in federal court in Denver

stories.headline: Brazil Blocks 28 Prediction Market Platforms Including Polymarket and Kalshi

key_facts.fact: Brazil blocked 28 prediction market platforms including Polymarket and Kalshi, Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced Friday in Brasilia
key_facts.excerpt: Brazil has blocked prediction market platforms and tightened derivatives rules to curb 'bet-like' products, Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Friday

key_facts.fact: Durigan said the platforms are not in compliance with betting regulations approved by Congress and therefore violate the law
key_facts.excerpt: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said the platforms violated betting regulations approved by Congress

key_facts.fact: Brazil also tightened derivatives rules to curb 'bet-like' financial products alongside the platform blocks
key_facts.excerpt: Brazil blocks prediction platforms, tightens rules to curb bet-like products

key_facts.fact: The move comes as the US CFTC simultaneously sued New York for overstepping its authority by targeting prediction market operators Coinbase and Gemini
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission sued New York on Friday, accusing the state of invading its authority to regulate prediction markets
